attacks.name: Strike
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains |!power| equal to the |!damage| dealt.
|!wild| |!hit| |*Throw|: Before |!damage| is dealt, this character may Throw the defender Away |!range_small|.

attacks.name: Cosmic Blast
steps: When creating the dice pool for this attack, this character may spend up to 3 |!power|. Add 1 die to this attack roll for each |!power| spent in this way.
|!wild| |*Titan's Will|: After this attack is resolved, Push the defender character Away |!range_small|. The pushed character gains the |§slow§Slow| special condition.

superPowers.name: Death‘s Agenda (Affiliation: Black Order)
superPowers.body: When an enemy non-Grunt character is KO'd, this character's controlling player scores 1 VP.|\|Additionally, this character may use the |!active| or |!reactive| superpowers of Infinity Gems without paying the |!power| Cost.

superPowers.name: Cosmic Portal
superPowers.body: Choose another allied character within |!range| 4 of this character. Place the chosen character within |!range| 2 of its current position. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: Death‘s Decree
superPowers.body: When another allied character within |!range| 4 of this character makes an attack, during the |*Create Attack Dice Pool| step, this character may use this superpower. If the attacker is Healthy, it adds 2 dice to its attack roll. If the attacker is Injured, it adds 4 dice to its attack roll. This superpower can be used only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: Being of Immeasurable Power
superPowers.body: When this character would suffer 1 or more |!damage| from an enemy effect, reduce the amount of |!damage| suffered by 1. Additionally, this character may have 2 Infinity Gems rather than the normally allowed 1.

superPowers.name: Gem Bearer [Mind, Power, Reality, Soul, Space, Time], Immunity [Stun], Peerless

erratas.body: The "Throw" special rule from "Strike" triggers on |!wild| |!hit| instead of |!wild| only.
"Death‘s Agenda" does not work on Grunts characters anymore. Its effect on the Injured side is now the same as on the Healthy side.
Not paying the Power cost for Infinity Gems' superpowers is now only possible if the Leadership ability is active
"Cosmic Portal" can now only target allied characters.
The timing for "Death‘s Decree" was changed from "when targeted" to "during the Create Attack Dice Pool step".
Thanos now has the Peerless innate superpower.
"Cosmic Portal" can now be used only once per Turn.
